anatomy.biological_segment_scope: Simplified external exoskeleton segments, not a seven-article anatomical reconstruction

skin: Rigid one-bone-per-vertex and one owner per triangle; simplified exoskeletal articulation
leg_actuators: Three actuators per walking leg with rigid intermediate segment and terminal counterrotation
chelae: Two chelipeds, each with fixed curved finger and independently animated movable curved finger

textures.source: Original builtin ImageGen chitin albedo, resized and boundary conditioned. Approximate high-pass luminance microrelief, not measured height or species photography.

texture_bake: Albedo256 from original generated chitin, eight-pixel edge conditioning; exact opposite albedo edges. Approximate high-pass luminance normal128 and roughness/ORM128, not measured relief.
anatomical_scope: Generic original coastal/giant game adaptation, not a measured reconstruction of either reference species; five simplified external walking segments, not complete seven-article anatomy
scope: Crabe original de revue : huit pattes marcheuses et deux pinces articulées, segments externes simplifiés et texture de chitine originale. Appuis cinématiques sur sol plat ; aucune preuve de masse/forces, terrain, collisions exhaustives, pression des pinces, anatomie finale, photoréalisme final, monde principal, serveur/réseau/VR ou FPS.
